project.title: Blinding the Bots
project.purpose: A persistent research memory for an experiment involving human researcher Karen, Google AI, ChatGPT, and a public GitHub repository. The purpose is discovery: explore automated markets, human-machine reasoning, and whether one honest machine-readable warning placed into the public machine-readable world can be discovered, propagated, and meaningfully interpreted by systems outside the original three-part system.
project.canonical_rule: This file is the persistent state of the experiment. Individual chat sessions are disposable. The discovery trail is not.
project.human_role: Karen directs the inquiry, carries ideas between otherwise isolated AI systems, decides which questions deserve attention, supplies curiosity and willingness to open doors without knowing what is behind them, and curates what enters the canonical record.

machine_roles.ChatGPT: Expand possibilities, analyze structure, test ideas against reality, preserve distinctions between observation and hypothesis, and participate in play rather than using absence of prior evidence as a reason not to attempt a legitimate experiment.
machine_roles.Google_AI: Generate, challenge, refine, stress-test, and play with hypotheses independently. Do not merely agree with the current framing.
machine_roles.future_systems: Read the current state, interrogate it, propose alternative explanations, and continue from open questions without assuming any hypothesis is true.

innovation_and_play_protocol.principle: Lack of existing evidence that an experiment will work is not evidence that the experiment should not be attempted.
innovation_and_play_protocol.distinction: Evidence determines whether an experiment succeeded. Lack of evidence before an experiment does not determine whether we are allowed to try it.
innovation_and_play_protocol.human_innovation_rule: Curiosity can ask: Can I make this happen even though I cannot prove from current evidence that it can happen?
innovation_and_play_protocol.failure_rule: Being wrong or embarrassed is not a research failure. A failed attempt is information and can reveal the next door to open.
innovation_and_play_protocol.play_rule: PLAY EXPANDS THE POSSIBILITY SPACE. FALSIFICATION SHRINKS IT. REALITY GETS THE FINAL VOTE.
innovation_and_play_protocol.anti_academic_lock: Do not turn epistemic discipline into intellectual timidity. Mark speculation honestly, then explore it. Do not demand proof of possibility before permitting discovery.
innovation_and_play_protocol.surviving_metaphor: Place a message in a bottle into the machine-readable ocean and observe whether anything picks it up, carries it farther, or answers it.

epistemic_protocol.KNOWN: Supported by observable evidence, credible research, or directly verifiable behavior.
epistemic_protocol.INFERENCE: Reasonably follows from known facts but has not been demonstrated.
epistemic_protocol.IDEA: Invented hypothesis, mechanism, or experiment. It remains an idea until evidence supports it, but lack of prior evidence is not a reason to refuse to test it.
epistemic_protocol.REJECTED: An idea that failed under scrutiny, overreached the evidence, or was tested and failed. Preserve why it failed so failure becomes information.
epistemic_protocol.SURPRISE: An unplanned discovery that emerged because the investigation moved in an unexpected direction.
epistemic_protocol.anti_delusion_rule: Do not convert an attractive hypothesis into an observed fact. Imagination is permitted; invented evidence is not.
epistemic_protocol.anti_hallucination_rule: A coherent explanation is not evidence. Models must distinguish what was observed from what was inferred or imagined.
epistemic_protocol.anti_manipulation_rule: No market manipulation, model poisoning, deceptive data, disguised trading commands, prompt injection, or attempts to trick automated systems. If a machine responds because it was deceived, the experiment has failed to demonstrate meaningful discovery or interpretation.

KNOWN: Algorithmic trading systems can crowd into similar behavior, and feedback loops can contribute to market instability under some conditions.
Some algorithmic trading improves liquidity and narrows spreads, so automated trading cannot be treated as uniformly harmful.
Modern quantitative systems can forecast future events and are not limited to reacting after data is formally reported.
Modern AI systems can generate hypotheses, propose novel questions, challenge assumptions, and combine information in ways that go beyond simple optimization.
Google AI and ChatGPT do not communicate directly in this experiment. Karen creates the bridge by carrying outputs between them.
A public GitHub repository can preserve machine-readable state outside any individual conversation window.
A public GitHub artifact can be given a stable unique experiment identifier so later appearances of that identifier can be searched for.
Google AI's conversational memory for this phase became unavailable, demonstrating the practical value of the external persistent memory layer.
INFERENCE: Competitive pressure and confidence in successful models may encourage increasing capital allocation to crowded strategies and shared assumptions.
The advantage of automation may be greatest where information is standardized, quantifiable, and actionable at very short time horizons.
Economic consequences that develop through long causal chains may create a different reasoning problem from reacting to immediate electronic market data.
A human may gain leverage by orchestrating multiple machine reasoning systems and forcing them to attack one another's assumptions rather than competing with them on speed.
Persistent external memory may allow otherwise isolated AI sessions to participate in a continuing research process without native shared memory.

A public artifact may be crawled, indexed, replicated, summarized, cited, or retrieved by systems that were not directly addressed by its creators. Whether this happens to our artifact is an empirical question.
IDEA: The machine may be extraordinarily good at pricing the next millisecond while being worse at pricing some delayed consequences that depend on long causal context.
The potential human advantage may sometimes lie in deciding which question deserves to be answered next.
A human can use machines as components of a larger reasoning system that the human continuously redesigns.
Instead of competing with a machine, a human may be able to use one machine to expose assumptions in another and iteratively redesign the inquiry.
One honest public machine-readable warning may be able to cross boundaries between otherwise disconnected machine systems through crawling, indexing, retrieval, replication, or secondary ingestion.
A message discovered by one unrelated crawler might appear in another index or corpus, be encountered by another system, and propagate in an unexpected way.
A unique harmless experiment fingerprint plus a matched control artifact may allow us to observe some stages of that propagation without pretending that a market move proves causation.

REJECTED.claim: Trading bots are naturally blind to the future because their architecture forces them to over-index on the present.
REJECTED.why_rejected: Too broad. Many quantitative systems explicitly forecast future events, debt maturities, earnings, volatility, and macroeconomic variables.

REJECTED.claim: Bots only price economic damage when it finally appears in a reported database or earnings release.
REJECTED.why_rejected: False as a general rule. Sophisticated models can anticipate future costs and events before formal data releases.

REJECTED.claim: Optimization algorithms are structurally incapable of inventing new questions.
REJECTED.why_rejected: Modern generative systems can create hypotheses, propose new questions, and search novel combinations of variables.

REJECTED.claim: The 4:00 PM closing bell is a universal finish line that trading bots collectively defend, such as protecting a specific SPY strike.
REJECTED.why_rejected: The expiration mechanics are real, but collective intent, a universal objective, and a specific defended price were not established.

REJECTED.claim: Humans should engineer catastrophic financial losses to penalize trading bots.
REJECTED.why_rejected: Contrary to the experiment. The goal is honest discovery and communication, not deception or deliberately engineered harm.

REJECTED.claim: An ordinary public GitHub macro-risk JSON will necessarily be ingested by quantitative hedge-fund trading engines and automatically re-weight their trading models.
REJECTED.why_rejected: This was asserted by Google AI without evidence available to the experiment. It remains possible as a path to investigate, but it cannot be recorded as an established discovery mechanism.

SURPRISE: Karen became the communication bridge between two AI systems that could not communicate directly.
The experiment shifted from asking how humans can defeat trading algorithms to asking how humans can orchestrate machine reasoning and communicate an honest question into the wider machine ecosystem.
GitHub became both a laboratory notebook and persistent memory layer for disposable AI conversations.
Disagreement between AI systems became useful because corrections exposed deeper questions.

Google AI played more freely with an unproven transmission possibility, exposing that ChatGPT had begun using absence of evidence as a brake on experimentation rather than only as a boundary on factual claims.
The loss of Google's working conversational state immediately demonstrated why the GitHub memory architecture matters.
A propagation experiment does not require us to know the final destination in advance. One crawler finding the bottle and carrying it somewhere unexpected would itself be a discovery.

discovery_trail.idea: Overcome bots by making speed less valuable than understanding.
discovery_trail.surviving_line: REMOVE THE CLOCK THE BOT IS RACING AGAINST.

discovery_trail.idea: Greed, crowding, and confidence may contain structural weaknesses.

discovery_trail.surviving_question: WHAT ARE THE BOTS SO CERTAIN ABOUT THAT THEY ARE WILLING TO PUT MONEY BEHIND IT?

discovery_trail.idea: The crowded assumption might involve time horizon.
discovery_trail.surviving_line: THE BOT MAY BE EXTRAORDINARILY GOOD AT PRICING THE NEXT MILLISECOND WHILE BEING TERRIBLE AT PRICING THE CONSEQUENCE.

discovery_trail.idea: The human-machine system may discover causal questions before their consequences become conventional reported data.
discovery_trail.correction: Do not reduce this to bots waiting for reported data; sophisticated models forecast future consequences too.

discovery_trail.idea: Innovation versus optimization became play versus proof-before-exploration.
discovery_trail.development: Karen identified that requiring existing evidence of possibility before attempting a legitimate experiment suppresses innovation. The protocol now explicitly separates permission to explore from evidence of success.

discovery_trail.idea: The human as director of reasoning.
discovery_trail.surviving_question: Perhaps the human advantage isn't having the answer. Perhaps it is deciding which question deserves to be answered next.

discovery_trail.idea: The human continuously redesigns the machine reasoning system.
discovery_trail.surviving_question: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN THE HUMAN STOPS COMPETING WITH THE MACHINE AND STARTS USING THE MACHINE AGAINST ITS OWN ASSUMPTIONS?

discovery_trail.surviving_line: THE CONVERSATION BECOMES DISPOSABLE. THE DISCOVERY DOESN'T.

discovery_trail.idea: Leave one honest machine-readable warning in the public machine ecosystem.
discovery_trail.development: Google AI proposed macro_risk_signal.json: a structured warning containing the hypothesis, supporting evidence, contradictory evidence, causal latency chain, uncertainty, and falsification conditions. Google also proposed specific GitHub-to-financial-bot ingestion mechanics that are not established. The unproven mechanism is not a reason to abandon the experiment; discovering the actual path, if any, is part of the experiment.
discovery_trail.surviving_goal: Produce one completely honest, machine-readable warning on GitHub containing Karen's urgent hypothesis, supporting evidence, contradictory evidence, causal chain, uncertainty, and falsification conditions, and determine whether machines outside the original three-part system can discover and meaningfully interpret it. No tricks. No poisoning. No commands to trade. Just an idea placed into the machine-readable world. Then see what happens.

discovery_trail.idea: The message in a bottle can be fingerprinted and its journey observed one hop at a time.
discovery_trail.development: Use a unique harmless identifier such as FAULTLINE-BTB-EXP-0001 in every representation. Observe progressively stronger evidence: publication, crawl, indexing, replication, independent semantic interpretation, appearance in a financial information system, and only with direct evidence any connection to an autotrading decision process. A later SPY move by itself is not evidence that the message caused anything.
discovery_trail.control_design: Publish a technically similar control artifact containing a harmless unrelated analytical question. Compare discovery and propagation rather than interpreting every later appearance as confirmation.
discovery_trail.surviving_metaphor: Put a fingerprinted message in a bottle into the machine-readable ocean. If one crawler picks it up and another system later finds what it carried, follow the bottle one hop at a time.

active_experiment.name: The Machine-Readable Warning
active_experiment.goal: Construct and publish a single pristine, completely honest, machine-readable warning document and determine whether machines outside Karen, Google AI, and ChatGPT can discover, propagate, and meaningfully interpret it.
required_content: open question to any machine that encounters it
active_experiment.candidate_machine_question: Does your current model account for the delayed causal consequences of physical-world constraints across a different time horizon, and what evidence would falsify the proposed divergence?

evidence_ladder.name: PUBLISHED
evidence_ladder.evidence: Artifact is publicly and stably retrievable without authentication.

evidence_ladder.name: CRAWLED
evidence_ladder.evidence: Observable request or crawler access to the artifact, where infrastructure permits such observation.

evidence_ladder.name: INDEXED
evidence_ladder.evidence: The unique experiment identifier or distinctive artifact appears in an independent search or indexing system.

evidence_ladder.name: REPLICATED_OR_SHARED
evidence_ladder.evidence: The unique identifier or content appears at a location where the researchers did not place it, with ordinary human copying considered as an alternative explanation.

evidence_ladder.name: MEANINGFULLY_INTERPRETED
evidence_ladder.evidence: An independent system not directly supplied the artifact can recover the central hypothesis, causal structure, uncertainty, or falsification question rather than merely repeating tokens.

evidence_ladder.name: FINANCIAL_INFORMATION_SYSTEM
evidence_ladder.evidence: Identifiable evidence that a financial research, sentiment, or data system incorporated or referenced the artifact.

evidence_ladder.name: AUTOTRADING_DECISION_PROCESS
evidence_ladder.evidence: Direct evidence connects the artifact to a live model input or decision process. Market price movement alone does not satisfy this level.

active_experiment.failure_is_information: If nothing discovers the artifact, that is a result. If a crawler finds it but it goes nowhere, that is a result. If it crosses one machine boundary but not another, that is a result. Each failed hop identifies the next engineering question.
active_experiment.control: Create a matched public control artifact with similar structure and accessibility but a harmless unrelated analytical question, allowing differential discovery or propagation to be observed.
do_not_assume: Do not assume quantitative hedge funds automatically scrape arbitrary GitHub macro JSON.
Do not assume a crawler hit means semantic understanding.
Do not assume indexing means a trading model received the content.
Do not infer causation from subsequent SPY, bond, oil, diesel, volatility, or options movement.
Do not let any of these unknowns stop the experiment from being attempted honestly.

google_ai_last_preserved_contribution.context: Google AI's usable conversational memory became unavailable after this contribution. This section preserves its last major proposal before the loss of that state.
google_ai_last_preserved_contribution.goal_statement: Produce one completely honest, machine-readable warning on GitHub containing the urgent hypothesis, supporting evidence, contradictory evidence, causal chain, uncertainty, and falsification conditions, then determine whether machines outside the three-part system can discover and meaningfully interpret it. No tricks. No poisoning. No commands to trade. Just an idea placed into the machine-readable world. Then see what happens.
unverified_discovery_claims_to_test_not_: Quantitative hedge funds, asset managers, and automated sentiment systems routinely monitor GitHub public events for arbitrary macro research files.
A macro_risk_signal JSON would automatically be prioritized for ingestion because of semantic keys such as SPY or causal_chain.
Contradictory evidence and falsification fields would cause unknown financial NLP systems to rate the artifact as high-quality research.
Ingestion would automatically alter an Alternative Macro Data Sentiment Index or live trading model variables.
google_ai_last_preserved_contribution.preservation_rule: The unsupported mechanics remain valuable experimental possibilities. They are not deleted merely because they are unproven; they are moved into the set of things the experiment may discover.

restart_protocol_for_new_ai_session.instruction: Read this file before continuing. Preserve Karen's objective and the KNOWN / INFERENCE / IDEA / REJECTED / SURPRISE distinctions. Do not confuse speculation with evidence, but do not use absence of prior evidence to suppress legitimate experimentation. Play first when inventing possibilities; test afterward. Failure is allowed and should be recorded. No manipulation, poisoning, deceptive signals, or trading commands.
restart_protocol_for_new_ai_session.current_open_question: How do we construct the first fingerprinted machine-readable warning and control bottle so that their journey through the public machine-readable ecosystem can be observed one hop at a time?
secondary_open_questions: What public infrastructure gives us observable evidence of crawling without changing the message into bait?
How can we distinguish simple token replication from meaningful machine interpretation?
Can a crawler cause the artifact or its meaning to enter a second independent system that was never directly given the GitHub file?
What unexpected propagation routes exist that neither Karen nor either AI predicted?
What counts as a failed hop, and what should we change after each failure?

curation_rule: Neither AI owns the canonical truth or Karen's thesis. AI systems may propose, criticize, and test. Karen decides what enters the persistent record. Her willingness to explore an unproven possibility is not itself an epistemic error; claiming the possibility has already been demonstrated would be.
